name: Geometry save keeps the raw fields the pilot did not change
step: Check the Mixer Geometry save round trip
rationale:
Issue #2792: Mixer > Geometry shows rounded values (cyclic and collective limits as tenths of a degree from 1/12-degree raw steps, geo correction halved), and its beforeSave rebuilt every raw field from them on any save: a raw limit of 1001 came back as 1000, the roll limits were replaced by the pitch limit, and each minimum was rewritten as -max. The page now writes only the raw fields behind the form values the pilot edited since the last read.

The harness drives the real mixer_geometry.lua with a stand-in runtime on raw data that does not round-trip: an unchanged save keeps every raw field, editing the phase writes only the phase, an edited cyclic limit is written to pitch and roll as +/- the limit and keeps the collective limit, an edited cyclic rate keeps each axis's direction and the limits, and a reload forgets the edits. --self-test makes the cyclic limit write unconditional and requires the untouched checks to fail.
